sections.text:
[Effects]
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 3XL.
Ignores 50% of the target's DEF and MDEF (cannot be stacked).
Target: yourself. Increases max HP by S for 20 seconds.
The greater the current HP is when attacking, the greater the increase of Ability Power up to a max of 4XL+.
Ability Power scales with the number of Book type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of 5XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
M
Activation rate scales with the number of Book type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of L (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).
